english.title: Person to whom card issued fail to notify Secretary of State and provide information of loss / theft - tachograph cards

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Passenger and Goods Vehicles Recording Equipment Tachograph Card Regulations 2006

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been issued with a tachograph card, namely a

(A)_[company card,]_
(B)_[control card,]_
(C)_[driver card,]_
(D)_[workshop card,]_

failed to

(E)_[notify the Secretary of State in writing]_
(F)_[provide such information or documents as required by the Secretary of State, namely **(..SPECIFY THE INFORMATION / DOCUMENTS..)]_

when the card was lost or stolen
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 5(1), (4) and (5) of the Passenger and Goods Vehicles (Recording Equipment) (Tachograph Card) Regulations 2006.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
